configuration.candidate_selection: Validation completed count, then duration coverage; full-set economic cost when all complete

training_td_fit.scope: actual optimizer minibatch draws before Adam; count includes repeat draws
training_td_fit.prefix_label_note: A streaming prefix remains normal_nonterminal until its voyage fails; historical draws retain their label at draw time.

checkpoint_replay_fit.scope: read-only stratified replay diagnostic; measured_count is not the replay population or actual optimizer draws
checkpoint_replay_fit.sampling: up to 8192 distinct entries per class; entire class when at most 8192
checkpoint_replay_fit.p95_note: P95 is exact for the saved diagnostic sample; it is not asserted to be the full-replay P95.

train_failure_value.interpretation: Only actual Train transitions; read-only checkpoint inference. Observed return is the realized epsilon-greedy trajectory return, not Q* or a counterfactual benefit. TD targets use current target-network masked max; they are moving learning targets. The first upper/lower failures are fixed for checkpoint comparisons; no report rows enter Replay.

q_reporting_contract.source: Only Train/warmup transitions enter Replay and Adam. Validation states are inference-only.
q_reporting_contract.residual: one-step TD target minus Q_online(s, executed_action)
q_reporting_contract.boundary_classification: Failure side: upper SOC>=0.79, lower SOC<=0.21, otherwise interior; reporting only.
q_reporting_contract.interpretation: TD targets move with the target network and are not Q*. Observed failure-prefix returns are behavior-policy returns, not optimal values.
q_reporting_contract.online_p95: 8192 independent reservoir per group; an estimate after more than 8192 actual draws.
q_reporting_contract.checkpoint_p95: Exact on saved stratified diagnostic samples, not necessarily full Replay.

warmup_replay_fit.scope: read-only stratified replay diagnostic; measured_count is not the replay population or actual optimizer draws
warmup_replay_fit.sampling: up to 8192 distinct entries per class; entire class when at most 8192
warmup_replay_fit.p95_note: P95 is exact for the saved diagnostic sample; it is not asserted to be the full-replay P95.

elapsed_resume_basis: last recorded progress; legacy checkpoint has no elapsed_seconds
